text: This report requests Council's authority for the City to assume the municipal roads and services within De Boers Drive, in accordance with the terms of the Subdivision Agreement for Plan 66M-2458, registered on July 20, 2007 between 1609830 Ontario Inc. and the City of Toronto. Two Site Plan Control approvals were issued on December 18, 2008 and February 3, 2010.
North York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until its meeting on July 4, 2018.
